purpose: Android QA showed charge animation as an electric ring rather than a thundercloud. Supply the missing cloud silhouette; existing sheet animates electricity.
prompt: Create one production sprite for a cozy medieval pixel-art idle RPG: a compact low, wide thundercloud seen straight from the side, a continuous solid silhouette of five overlapping lumpy cloud lobes, dark dusty slate-lavender shadows with muted gray-violet upper planes. No lightning, no rain, no particles, no sky, no horizon, no frame, no text, no face. This is the cloud alone; electricity will be animated separately by the game engine. Genuine transparent background. Sparse 48 by 24 pixel logical grid, deliberately chunky hand-placed pixel-art clusters and crisp staircase edges, no antialiasing, no gradients, no black outline. Exactly four restrained gray-purple colors. Slightly asymmetric larger central lobe, flattened underside and soft rounded but pixelated silhouette. Object fills 85 percent of a wide 2:1 canvas, entirely inside the canvas with transparent margin. Render the logical pixel grid at a large integer multiple with strictly flat colors. Keep the cloud broad and solid enough to remain identifiable when displayed 160 pixels wide over a green forest battlefield. A restrained game VFX sprite, not a detailed illustration.
